## ORCA invariants check

Confirm this feature can be implemented without breaking any of the following:

- [ ] `npm test` stays at **3318/3318** (or the new count is documented)
- [ ] All **11 Indian languages** remain fully localised
- [ ] The engine stays **keyless and deterministic** — offline use is not broken
- [ ] Product tokens, agent names, severity codes stay **verbatim**
